Zen Garden

Suburban Almanac

Choice Present

Pick anything you want! It costs C.

🧟 Zombie Hunt

Each map has its own zombies: further maps are tougher and pay better. Beat the zombie by bringing enough combined coin production. The fight takes a while, and a win pays a modest amount of coins, with only a chance at a sprout, items or Mega Fertilizer.

🗺️ Neighbourhood Map

Send plants on expeditions (they leave the garden until they return) to find presents, or hunt zombies. Maps unlock as you do more.

🏆 The Gold Garden

Sacrifice five Mythic plants to build it. Only plants with 3★ mastery or more can move in, and they earn +50% there.
